about: Saturday playbook steps (B6), attached to the organisers' schedule by `bazaar timeline --plays docs/night/saturday-plays.json --json`. Times are triggers (feed events), not clocks: wall times are expectations under the resume / jump anchor. Points: Saturday round points from W5's score model (PR #78); 1 Saturday round point = 0.40 final game points. Duel, trade, bench and venue weights are W5's ASSUMED values (12.5 / 5 / 15 / 15); only the ladder weight (12.5) is fitted.

gates.question: Which clock column?
gates.check: uv run bazaar clock (keyless): t_hours ~2.65 = resume, ~4.0 = jump; uv run bazaar timeline --from-api --compare docs/night/saturday-schedule.json (organisers may re-time at_hours instead of jumping the clock); confirm 09:01-09:05: round 2 schedule.fired + 150 P gift.given by 09:03 and bazaar clock round 2 = jump; neither by 09:05 and round 1 = resume; the feed wins over either column (the admin calendar doc hints events may follow jump wall times even if t_hours resumes)
gates.then: use that column; if --compare lists changes, only the live bazaar timeline --from-api output counts

gates.question: What code is live at 09:00?
gates.check: Railway: bazaar-taker and bazaar-maker have BAZAAR_LIVE=1, bazaar-duels runs `duel run --play` (main's v1); railway variable list per service shows DATABASE_URL
gates.then: Marius merges the safety PRs he wants (#60 before Duels II at the latest; #61 has 2 open P1s; #62 refuses to start live without a shared DATABASE_URL); a GUARDRAILS.md change reaches Railway only on a redeploy; PR #71's head (since 03:23) sets allow_venue_open = true, cash_floor 100 + venue_bond_reserve 270 and has the maker open a board venue at t_hours >= 6.5: under resume that is 12:51, the Duels I start tick, and 353 < 370 blocks every buy until the 10:24 grant

gates.question: BAZAAR_LEARN on bazaar-taker?
gates.check: railway variable list --service bazaar-taker: #89 (merged 06:24) makes the live taker skip dealers under learned blockers unless BAZAAR_LEARN=0; over-blocking risks: a card persona_quota refusal blocks that dealer's packs for the hour, an unseen sold_out blocks the whole dealer for the hour. #145 (merged) keeps our only copy of any RET/CHA page card from being sold (protect_page_sets = RET,CHA)

gates.question: Is this a safe moment to merge?
gates.check: a merge to main touching src/**, GUARDRAILS.md, STRATEGY.md, RUNTIME.md, uv.lock, pyproject.toml, vendor/bazaar-kit/**, questions/** or .railway/** redeploys bazaar-duels, bazaar-taker and bazaar-maker (.railway/railway.py watchPatterns)
gates.then: merge before 09:00 or only between duel sessions; never inside Duels I/II or a Market Test with a venue open; #72 (now contains #61 + #68; merge commit, never #61 alone, close #68 by hand) before 09:00: main's taker can break cash_floor and the 150/h cap in one tick (r2 X7); after any redeploy the taker's dealer threads are orphaned (r2 X3, B17): uv run bazaar threads --status open, Marius closes the orphans one by one (SDK close_thread); bazaar flatten --live --threads (#68) is a last resort after PAUSE: it cancels every offer, the maker's too, and walks healthy ladder threads; on by default once merged: #89 (learning taker, BAZAAR_LEARN=0 turns it off), #91 (evals inside duels/taker/maker every 6 ticks), #71's head (venue opens on its own at h 6.5); X15 (r2): expired maker bids are reposted and their spend booked again, filling max_spend_per_game_hour; the stopgap offer_ttl_ticks ~1 game hour is a code change (merge inside a window), the proper fix is B14

gates.when: first board refresh after round 2 starts (resume 10:21 / jump 09:00)
gates.question: Does the ladder restart per round?
gates.check: uv run bazaar evals score-check (#78) or /me score.ladder_points: 0 = restart
gates.then: restart: Saturday's best three Abuela deals are worth 10.7 round points at Friday's top-3 mean (7.9 at 1.5), run them now; carry-over: Friday's deals stand, best three 0.733 -> 0.95 is worth 2.44

gates.when: after the first Market Test of the day (resume h3 09:21-09:29 / jump h5 10:00-10:08)
gates.question: Does the free stall score for us?
gates.check: /me score.bench_points, bench_venue, bench_efficiency (this PR's uv run bazaar status prints them; on main the monitor's agent.me snapshot)
gates.then: bench_points > 0 with no venue: the stall scores, a venue adds ~+0.19 final (B2) for 270 P locked, decide calmly; null or 0: every session without a venue costs 0.94 round points (0.38 final), open the venue (B2 runbook) as soon as Marius approves

gates.question: Sign of days?
gates.check: uv run bazaar duel done / the duels log: days_meaning and your_days_weight on the first two-issue payload
gates.then: keep duel_days_signed = false (#86) unless days_meaning states the sign (B8)

gates.question: Chato?
gates.then: three Chato deals at share 0.5: +2.82 round points (carry-over); 3 negotiated Chato deals are probably also what unlocks level 3 early (Abuela's unlock rule: early_min_deals 3; assumed the same for Chato)

gates.question: duel_policy v1 or v2?
gates.check: #86 (stacked on #60): W2a gate GO 5/5, 1.42x at 0.06/0.08, 0 outside-limit closes
gates.then: v2 needs #60 + #86 merged and bazaar-duels redeployed before the session; otherwise v1 with #60

standing.note: first claim on the team's one accept per tick; must be up for every duel session: a missed session costs its whole share
spend and pack quotas count per GAME hour: under resume the hours turn at :21
maker cancels are uncapped (W5: up to 45 calls in a tick); never a second laptop running taker + maker

standing.command: uv run bazaar monitor --notify  (one laptop only)
standing.note: alerts on schedule.fired, level.*, venue.opened, day.*; run it all day: the Railway monitor was removed, so feed_events is fresh only while a laptop monitor runs; after any redeploy check the newest feed_events tick = the clock's tick (r2 X23)

standing.command: while true; do uv run bazaar broker run --live --bench-policy edge --read-offset 0.5; sleep 2; done
standing.params: #71 + #84 + #92; only once a board venue is open
standing.note: a board venue whose broker is down scores 0 in that session (B2: break-even ~6 % downtime); with #71's current head merged the Railway maker's VenueKeeper runs the broker (exact) itself: never start this laptop loop as well (two brokers on one key, r1)

unscheduled.do: #106 (merged 05:07) wakes the loops at the announced opening; restart bazaar-duels, bazaar-taker and bazaar-maker only if one shows no tick by 09:01
read GET /api/levels and B3's persona plan (#93); nothing to send
unscheduled.friday: Chato announced t1.18, activated t1.63 (27 min later), open to all +1.0 h

unscheduled.do: if we earned it: open a thread within the head start; otherwise it opens to us after opens_to_all_in_hours
unscheduled.friday: we unlocked Chato at activation with 4 Abuela deals

unscheduled.do: re-run uv run bazaar timeline --from-api; a pace change moves every session end

events.do: Friday's doors closed at 23:00 with the clock frozen at h 2.65 (tick 159).
Doors open at 09:00 on the calendar in both columns. G0 at 08:55 picks the column; #106 (merged) wakes the services at the opening; restart one only if it shows no tick by 09:01.
Resume only: the practice session froze mid-way (our 6 live + 8 not started at tick 159) and resumes at 09:00 for ~33 ticks. Not scored. It still takes the duel loop's first claim on the accept slot.

events.who: broker (if a board venue is open)
events.do: The hard Market Test (12 traders, firmer, more impatient). Same broker loop; --bench-preset hard is optional (priors only).
events.points: 0.94 round points at stall level, 1.88 at the top-3 mean (assumed weight 15 / 8 sessions)

events.who: broker (if a board venue is open), else nothing
events.do: Market Test: 16 ticks (8 min at 30 s). Our best venue open during it counts; none counts 0 unless the free stall scores for us (G3). Keep the broker loop alive; do not close or pause a venue during a session.
events.points: 0.94 round points at stall level, 1.88 at the top-3 mean (assumed weight 15 / 8 sessions)

events.do: Round 2 starts: Saturday's round (weight 1). Run G2 on the first board refresh. Under resume, 09:00 to this moment was still Friday's round (weight 0.5).

El Retiro released: RET cards enter packs, dealer menus (sets: released) and boards. Price RET cards from our live your_value (GET /api/me/value?card=RET-01) before listing; the taker and maker read it themselves.

+150 P and a sobre_barrio pack. Marius opens every sealed pack by hand (r2 X21: nothing in our code opens packs): the Friday welcome pack (asset 425) and this one, SDK open_pack(asset_id) = POST /api/packs/{id}/open on each kind=pack asset in /api/me; repeat hourly while the taker may buy packs, until B20. Cash 353 -> 503; headroom over cash_floor 270: 83 -> 233. Then re-run uv run bazaar plan pages (#87) and uv run bazaar trade-plan --live (#79, read-only) Hand-posted board offers are cancelled by the live maker within a tick (r2 X19): send W4's thread swaps only, or switch bazaar-maker to dry run (railway variable delete BAZAAR_LIVE --service bazaar-maker) while hand offers stand. If #71's head is merged the maker also runs our venue's broker: never dry-run it around a Market Test; thread swaps only.

Duels I: price only, decay 0.06, 34 duels per team, 3 at a time, 16 ticks each: up to 192 ticks (96 min). Overlaps the next Market Test. Keep bazaar-duels up the whole window; check bazaar duel done after the first wave. Accept race (r2 X17): the taker reserves the one accept at 2 s, a Jev-slow duel tick books it at up to 3.5 s; v1 is exposed, #86 v2 fixes it.
events.check: uv run bazaar duel done; outcomes in bazaar evals report
events.points: 12.5 round points at the top-3 mean if Duels I and II share the duel component (assumed); 0.18 per duel if sessions weigh equally

events.do: Duels II: price + delivery day, decay 0.08, 68 duels per team, 6 at a time: up to 192 ticks (96 min). #60 must be live before it (main's v1 closed outside the limit in 67/2800 two-issue zoo duels, #60 in 0/2800). Run G4 on the first payload. Overlaps the same-hour Market Test: 6 live duels = 9 calls a tick (W5).
events.points: 0.09 per duel at the top-3 mean if sessions weigh equally (assumed)

events.do: 23:00 doors close: offers stay open and nothing settles overnight; anything open settles at Sunday's first tick at Saturday's prices. Review our open offers (uv run bazaar sell offers) before 22:55.
Round 3 (Sunday). Under resume it lands Sun 10:21, not 09:00.
Sunday: two issues, decay 0.10, 12-tick duels, 4 at a time.

probes.question: t_hours: jump to 4.0 or resume at 2.65?
probes.probe: GET /api/clock (`t_hours`, `tick`) + GET /api/schedule: `uv run bazaar clock`, `uv run bazaar timeline --from-api --compare docs/night/saturday-schedule.json`
probes.decides: G0: the column for the day

probes.question: What does a closed clock carry (`next_tick_in`, `next_opens`)?
probes.decides: r2's B13 fix for the 300 s wake-up (X4)

probes.question: Do our dealer-thread bids appear in /api/me/offers?
probes.probe: GET /api/me/offers (key, read) with one dealer thread open: `uv run bazaar sell offers`
probes.decides: every cash-floor guard for thread bids (X7)

probes.question: Do duel accepts count against accepts_per_team_per_tick?

probes.decides: G4: #60's worst case vs B8's signed days
